Commentary.Commentary: We have another hour's play left today. So the Kiwis will look to score some quick runs and end the day on the front foot. Remains to be seen how the Zimbabwean bowlers fare against the might of the New Zealand firepower.

Wagner was the bowler to watch out for, returning career best figures of 20.5-8-41-6. Once again he bowled hard and gave it everything he had. It took longer than expected but he'll be happy with his performance. Southee was immense too at the other end, especially when he returned for another spell. The spinners were tidy and did their job well. A good performance indeed. Don't go anywhere, folks, as New Zealand's first innings will begin in a few short minutes.

After more than doubling Zimbabwe's total, both batsmen were sadly denied their half-centuries, with Tiripano just falling just by 1 run. They put up a good fight and gave their side something to lift their spirits.

That ends the innings for Zimbabwe, bowled out on 164. They managed to string together 44 runs in 22.5 overs after Tea. Tiripano and Masvaure put up a truly heroic partnership, scoring the highest 9th wicket partnership ever for Zimbabwe, an 85-run partnership.

OUT! AND ZIMBABWE HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT! Was just getting there, with each ball and he's finally gotten the perfect line. A good length delivery on middle, a touch of reverse swing on that as the ball straightens up a bit. Chinouya is caught here as he tries to put bat on ball. The ball beats the outside edge and knocks the bails over. And with that, ZIMBABWE FINISH THEIR INNINGS ON 164!
Full ad well outside off, watchfully left to the keeper.
Outside off, left alone.
BEATEN! Length ball outside off, Chinouya fails to put bat on ball.

Length ball outside off, Chinouya thinks to defend it but hesitates and the ball flashes past the off stump. It's a struggle for survival here as the batsmen tries to stay on so that Tiripano can reach his half century.
Fuller outside off, punched through the off side.
Full on the stumps, Chinouya gets an inside edge and the ball goes to mid on. The batsmen run a single.
Short on middle and leg, Mike ducks to avoid the ball as it passes over his head.
Fullish down the leg side, awkwardly defended to the leg side. This is a good effort by the number 11 batsman.
Short ball around off, Chinouya leans back to avoid it and edges it to the keeper but the ball doesn't carry.
Full on middle and off, defended to the off side.
A bouncer to end the over. Tiripano looks to hook this but is unable to connect. Clever bowling from Wagner, keeps the No.11 on strike.
Fired in on off, driven down to mid off for no run.
FOUR! Shot. Full outside off, Tiripano once again swings his bat and swings his bat. Gets it through backward point and away to the fence for a boundary. He's just one shy of his fifty here.
Quite full and angling in on middle and off, Donald with a nice straight bat bunts it back in the direction of the bowler.
Banged in short on middle and off, ducks to let it go over him.

Wagner comes around the wicket, bowls it fuller way outside off, Tiripano throws his bat at that. Clears the infield and the sends the ball over cover-point to pick up a couple of runs. Seems he's going for it since his partner has departed.
He's definitely got it reversing now. Lovely length ball outside off which heavily comes back in slightly after going past the batsman. Super stuff and a good over comes to and end.
Comes from over the wicket, bowls it full and aiming at the stumps, Chinouya does well to keep it out.
MICHAEL CHINOUYA is the last man in.

OUT! On the pads! Fuller ball around off, the ball seams in again. This time Masvaure gets on the front foot to push it away but misjudges the length. He misses his shot, the ball angles in and hits his pads. The fielding side makes an appeal for LBW and the umpire concurs as the ball seems to have gone on the clip the leg stump! That is the biggest wicket so far, and one sure to come as a big relief for NZ!
Length delivery outside off once more, luring the batsman out, left alone.
Terrific ball! Length ball outside off and swinging in sharply, good leave by Prince.
Southee now has a change of angles, comes from around the wicket to the southpaw. Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Shorter one going way down leg, ducked and evaded.
Length ball outside off, touch fuller and angling in, Tiripano opens the face of the bat and steers it straight to the gully fielder.
Length ball way outside off, no-brainer for Donald to let that through.
Bouncer which is going down the leg side, no problem for the batsman to duck and let it be.

Oooh.. close call actually. Fuller length ball outside off, Tiripano looks to leave it alone but is late to raise his bat. It ends up to point off the bottom half of the bat. Risky stuff, could have easily dragged that back onto the stumps as well.
Wagner from around the wicket now, bowls it up and aims the base of off stump, Donald brings his bat down in time and punches it to the cover region.
Fuller delivery outside off, Masvaure reaches out to it, drives it straight to the man at covers.
A change in length, it's banged in short on middle and leg, went for the pull shot but misses it completely.

Straying on the pads, Masvaure looks to flick it away but misses and is rapped on the pads. A stifled appeal for an lbw but the umpire isn't even remotely interested in it as the ball pitched outside the line of leg stump.
Better line this time. FUll and swinging in on middle and off, seems Southee can still get it to move around, Prince stands tall and drives it back out.
Southee with a length delivery angled across the southpaw, arms are once again shouldered to this one. No need to play at those at all.

Watling wants to change his gloves. Seems the webbing on it has come off and he signals for another one. Along with that, drinks are coming on to the field as well. This will allow the players can refresh themselves up a bit too.
A length ball angled across the batsman, no shot offered on that occasion as it's well away from him.

FOUR! That's a double bluff. Went for the yorker and it's gone away for a boundary. Wagner attempts to fire in a yorker on leg, it's just going a little down the leg side and Tiripano flicks this away nicely. Gets it all the way to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Another one well outside off, Donald raises his bat skywards to let the ball go past him and into the keeper's gloves.
Really full outside off, Tiripano shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller in length again, Wagner once again putting his back into it, it's pushed to covers for no run.
Length ball outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Wagner from around the wicket, bowls it full around off, Donald looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Yorker fired in on the toes, it connects and there's a huge appeal for an lbw. Seems to have caught the bat as well as the ball goes towards square leg. A run is taken.
Variates the length again as he pitches it full on middle and leg, swinging in, worked to the on side.
Takes the batsman by surprise as Southee bangs this one short out of the blue. Tiripano is caught but does well to hop and tap it down in the ground on the leg side. Top stuff from the Kiwi pacer.
Fired in on middle and off, seems Tim is looking to make full use of the reverse swing and york him out, Tiripano does well to drive it back.
Another delivery fuller on the stumps, Donald with a strong front foot defense.

Southee comes steaming in, pitches it up full on angling into the pads, seems to be getting some reverse swing immediately as Tiripano looks to flick it away. Is rapped on the pads as the ball rolls away to the leg side.
TIM SOUTHEE is back into the bowling attack.
Length ball outside off, Prince nearly inside edges it back onto his stumps.
Back of a length and around off, Masvaure looks to punch it but gets a bottom edge.
Length ball outside off, Prince swings and misses.
Fuller ball on middle, Prince looks to work it but misses and is hit on the pads.
Good length delivery outside off, cut through the off side.
Length ball down the leg side, Masvaure looks to flick but misses.
WAGNER is back on.
Fuller on the stumps, defended back to the bowler.
On the stumps, defended off the front foot.
Tossed up off spinner, Tiripano lets it through again.
Floated outside off, left alone.
Loopy ball on middle, defended to the leg side.
Length ball outside off, cut through point for a single.
Superb stuff from Sodhi. Bowls a googly just around off, Masvaure is beaten at all ends as he tries to put bat on ball.
Some nice flight given to this, outside off, driven down to mid off. No run taken.
FOUR! Two in two for Prince. Another fine execution of the same shot, in the same area. Gets down on one knee and sweeps it away to the fine leg boundary.
FOUR! Shot. Tossed up on leg, Masvaure kneels down and sweeps it superbly well to send it across the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Drags the length back a bit, pitches it just outside off, Masvaure rocks back and plays this late. Cuts it behind point and takes a couple of runs. Nicely played.
Full on the stumps, driven back towards the bowler.
Tossed up outside off once more, Tiripano defends it this time.
BEATEN! Slow delivery, tossed up outside off, Tiripano looks to play the slog sweep but fails to connect.
Short and the batsman defends it a tad late.
Full around off, defended off the front foot.
Pitched on the leg stump, driven to mid on.
Full around off, driven through the covers.
Landed outside off, played to point for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Tossed up outside off, defended to point.
Slightly flatter, around and defended to the off side.
Loopy ball on off, driven to the covers.
Flatter one on middle and leg, Masvaure is too early into the shot as he tries flicking this away. The ball goes off the pad. Maybe taking a slight inside edge. End of the over.
Tossed up outside off, Prince drives it towards mid off. Gets no run for it.
Drifting away from the batsman, outside off and a little fuller in length, Masvaure lunges forward to block it out with a good straight bat.
A flatter delivery which keeps a little low, drifting in on middle and leg, nudged down to fine leg for an easy single.
Floats it up nicely around off, it's pushed to the cover region for no run.
Shorter and flatter one around off, Donald goes back and keeps this one out.
Outside off, Masvaure has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Another good one! Pitched on the stumps and spinning away, the ball spins away from the bat and goes to the keeper who is ready for a stumping but the batsman is in the crease.
BEATEN! Sodhi changes his angle and Prince who is looking to block it, misses his shot.
Landed outside off, pushed to point.
Full ball around off, driven through mid off.
Full ball outside off, blocked off the front foot to the off side.
Pitched outside off, cut through to point.
Tossed up around off, defended to silly point.
On the stumps, blocked with a straight bat back to the bowler.
Landed around off, defended to the off side.
Outside off, left alone.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Prince looks to block it and the ball takes an outside edge and nearly carries to the slips.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short ball on the stumps, half pulls it through to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Smashed! Sodhi flights it wide outside the off stump and Tiripano slaps it through mid off for a boundary.
Landed on middle and off, played through mid-wicket.
Looped in, wide outside off, cut to point.
Quicker one pushed through just outside off, an arm ball really, yorked Tiripano and he was lucky the ball didn't hit the off stump. It was that close. Solid end to the over from Santner.
Shorter in length and outside off, Donald rocks back and punches it through the gap in the covers to pick up a couple of runs. Good placement.
On off, fullish in length, the right-hander presses ahead and buries it into the ground.
Another front foot defense presented by Donald to keep this one out.
Quicker one outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Continues from around the wicket, floats it up around off, Tiripano comes forward to keep it out.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Floated around off, Masvaure looks to block it but edges it to point.
FOUR! PRINCE FINDS THE GAP AGAIN! Length ball outside off, Prince gets into place, angles his bat and cuts it through the covers for another boundary and it might just be better than the first!
Around off, Prince punches it off the back foot to mid off.
FOUR! CUT AWAY! Short ball outside off,makes room and cuts it through the covers for a boundary.
BEATEN! Looped in around off, the ball spins away and nearly takes an outside edge.
Nicely looped up on off, Tiripano prods forward and keeps it out.
A solid front foot block by the batsman to keep this full ball out.
Tossed up outside off, the batsman gets an outside edge to point as he comes forward to block it.
Floats it up on the stumps, Donald drives it back down the ground.
From around the wicket this time, hit back to the bowler.
From over the wicket, tossed up around off, driven to mid on for a single.
Full around off, blocked to the covers.
Flighted ball outside off, more shape to it, Donald leaves it alone.
Full around off, blocked to the covers.
Full on middle, Tiripano shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fuller ball, solidly driven off the back foot through covers for a single.
Pitched outside off, the ball spins in sharply and is punched away.
Full around off, defended off the front foot to the covers.
Full on the stumps, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Tiripano defends it from within the crease.
BEATEN! Prince looks to defend it but the ball spins away and he misses.
Pitched outside off, defended with a straight bat to the covers.
Loopy ball around off, defended of the front foot to the off side.
SANTNER will bowl from the other end.
50-run stand between Masvaure and Tiripano!
Full around off, driven through mid off for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Tiripano steps forwards and pads it to the off side.
Tiripano shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Another slow ball outside off, played to point.
Wide outside off and short, Prince punched that slowly spinning ball for a single.
Landed outside off, defended to the off side.
The players are back in the middle. DONALD TIRIPANO and PRINCE MASVAURE are set to resume their batting and SODHI will continue the bowling proceedings.
... DAY 1, SESSION 3...

However, the unlikely pair of Prince Masvaure and Donald Tiripano hung in there, batting out the storm of bouncers and slowly restored ground for the hosts. The two have put up a 48-run partnership, easily the best of the innings and pushed Zimbabwe over the three-digit mark. How long can the partnership stand? Join us back in a few minutes.

As Tea came closer, the Rhodesian tail-enders have reclaimed this session back from the visitors. Raza and Ervine continued their partnership at the start of the 2nd session but had trouble playing the shorter deliveries. Santner claimed his second scalp of the innings to break the partnership. Following him was the dreaded, Neil Wagner, who claimed three in the next over and Zimbabwe looked to be in very dire straits.
Flatter one on middle and off, worked to the leg side off the back foot for no run. Tidy over from Santner. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 1!
Fuller delivery around off, a solid front foot defense from the batsman.
Shorter in length around off, he's squared up a bit as he goes back but manages to dab it gently to the off side.
Going down the leg side, Donald doesn't bother with it.
Drags the length back a bit, some sharp turn off the surface, it's played to point.
From around the wicket, flatter one on the stumps, Tiripano strides half-forward to keep it out.
MITCHELL SANTNER to bowl the last over before Tea.
From around the wicket to Masvaure, a floated one which straightens up after pitching, the southpaw is beaten as he tries to block it out.
Around off, Donald gets an inside edge to the leg side and they take a single for it.

FOUR! The guy that would have taken that catch has retired. Nicely tossed up outside off, Tiripano goes down on one knee and swings his bat hard at this. Doesn't connect well and it still goes well over a flying Martin Guptill who hurts himself as he dives behind to to take it. His knee got stuck in the ground as he fell.
Tossed up outside off, pushed to covers for no run.
Floats it up around off, blocked off the front foot.
From around the wicket this time, a leg spinner outside off, shorter in length and coming sharply in to the batsman, Prince rocks back and cuts it through point to pick up a single.
Length ball wide outside off, left alone.
BEATEN! Length ball outside off, Tiripano looks to defend it off the front foot but the ball shapes away and he misses.
Back of a length ball around off, a solid defence to the off side.
FOUR! What a beauty! Full on off, Tiripano plays a very orthodox drive through mid on and to the boundary line.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Donald tries to pull it but miscues it because of the variable bounce and pace.
Fuller ball, defended to the covers.
Fuller ball outside off, pushed off the front foot to the covers for a single.
Full ball around off, driven to the covers. At 38 runs this is the longest partnership so far.
Loopy ball outside off, defended to the off side.

SIX! First bad ball of the innings and that's been dispatched! Shorter and flatter on middle and off, Tiripano rocks back, gets into the position quickly and pulls it well over the mid-wicket boundary for a biggie. Super shot.
Tossed up on middle and off, Masvaure drives it to mid off and takes on the fielder there. Runs hard and makes it in easily.
Extremely full on middle and off, almost a yorker, dug out back to the bowler.
Fuller ball outside off, Tiripano defends it off the front foot to the off side.
Back of a length outside off, the ball angles away sharply and is an easy leave for the batsman.
Short ball on middle and shaping in, Tiripano ducks to avoid it.
Short ball on middle and off, pulled to square leg.
Length ball down the leg side, gets a little inside edge off the pads and to fine leg.
From around the wicket, a short one around off, Prince gets down to let it go over him.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Slower one around off, punched off the back foot to the off side once more.
Fullish and outside off, driven to the off side for no run.
Nicely tossed up outside off, slower through the air as well, easy leave for Donald.
Touch shorter on off, goes back and punches it to point.
Loopy leg spinner on middle and leg, pitched just shorter of a full length, Masvaure goes back, is cramped for room but manages to work it towards square leg for a single.
Full on the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Donals steps forward and defends it off the front foot presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller ball, driven through the covers.
Bouncer! Donald ducks and the ball goes over him.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Fuller outside off, Tiripano steps forward and drives it through the covers. The ball outruns the fielders and makes it to the fence.
WAGNER is back on.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Outside off, the ball takes a leading edge to gully. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floated on middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
Full outside off, driven through the covers.
Masvaure has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Loopy ball over the wicket, it lands around off and Prince dances forward and smashes it down the ground, through mid on and across the ropes.
Back of a length ball outside off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Full around off, driven back to the bowler.
Bouncer! On middle, the ball shapes in and Tiripano ducks to let it through.
Fuller ball outside off, driven off the front foot to the covers.
Short inswinger around off, Donald ducks low to evade it.
Fullish on the stumps, driven to mid on.
Shorter and flatter on middle, a back foot punch to covers by Prince.
Wrong 'un around off, well disguised as Masvaure is beaten on the wild slog.

An lbw shout which is turned down! Lovely tossed up leg spinner on middle and off, Masvaure presses forward to defend it but is rapped on the front pad. Appeals are made for a leg before it's rightly turned down by the umpire as the ball would have gone on to miss the leg stump.
Some nice flight on this given by Sodhi, it's a full toss which Prince drives towards wide mid on.
Tossed up on middle and off, Masvaure kneels down to sweep this but is too early into the shot. Goes off the back of the bat towards mid-wicket.
Floated on off, buried into the ground in front.
Length ball around off, a back foot defense from Tiripano to end the over.
On the thigh pad, nudged away for an easy single.

Southee showing some aggression there. Good to see. The game needs it from time to time. Full and fired in on middle and off, Masvaure drives it back to Tim. He collects the ball and instantly has a shy at the striker's end as the southpaw batsman gets out of the way. Good, healthy stuff.
On a length and outside off, no shot offered on that occasion.
Another one which is short of a length, around off, tighter line as well and it's blocked comfortably off the back foot.
Shortish delivery outside off, let through for the keeper to collect.
Quicker one pushed through around off, Donald Tiripano strides forward and pushes it to covers.
Leg break outside off, left alone.
On middle, some heavy turn for Ish Sodhi, Tiripano does well though to rock back and push it to the off side.
Fullish around off, Donald prods forward and buries it into the ground.

In the air... but safe! Donald is lucky there. Nicely tossed up outside off, Tiripano kneels down and swings his bat at this. Gets a top edge which clears wide mid off comfortably. Two runs are taken.
Shorter around off, played to short leg off the back foot.
Short and outside off, ducked to evade.
Full around off, an attempted yorker by Southee, it's firmly driven to mid on but good stop by Wagner there.
Another short one on the body, Southee is trying to cramp the batsman for room, Prince does well to hop slightly and work it gently to the leg side.
Another shortish delivery outside off, the southpaw dabs it towards the point region.
Back of a length on middle and off, Masvaure rises and taps it down into the ground.
Tim starts off with a bouncer. Bangs it in short around off, angling away, easy leave for the left-hander.
TIM SOUTHEE is back into the attack.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and looped up on the stumps, Donald drives this towards mid on.
Flatter one on off, blocked out comfortably.
Floats it up nicely around off, Tiripano goes a little straighter this time and drives it towards mid off.
Tossed up delivery outside off, driven to the covers. No run taken by the batsmen.
Sodhi has a gully in place now.
Some good turn for Sodhi on that occasion. Pitches in middle and leg and it spins towards the off stump. Tiripano goes back and does well to push it to the off side.
Length ball outside off, left alone to end the over.
On a length and just outside the off stump, the batsman stays deep within the crease and blocks it out.
Fuller in length and outside off, Prince with a solid front foot block.

FOUR! Lovely shot. And he's played it so well. Full delivery on middle and off, Masvaure leans forward and makes excellent use of his wrists. Flicks it ever so well through mid-wicket to send the ball racing across the ropes.
Full on the stumps this time, but the same result. Driven to the mid off fielder for no run.
Full and outside off, driven to mid off.
Googly on middle and leg, shorter in length and it's quite flat as well, Donald rocks back and tucks it to the on side for a couple of runs.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flights this one up on off, pushed to covers for no run.
Some good turn on that, but it's slow through the air and it gives enough time to the batsman to get back and keep it out.
Floats it up around off, Tiripano comes forward and blocks it out.
Tossed up nicely outside off, it's worked through cover-point for a single.
ISH SODHI finally comes into the attack.
Drinks break...
Full toss on middle, it is an attempted yorked that Tiripano digs out to mid on.
Short ball outside off, defended to the off side.
Short ball on middle and off, Tiripano pulls it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, defended to the off side. Nice variance of length to put the batsman off balance.
Back of a length ball outside off, left alone.
Short ball on middle, flicked to square leg for a single.
BOULT is back on.
A failed yorker attempt that passes wide down the leg side. Easy leave for the batsman.
Short ball around off, Tiripano stands tall and blocks with the full face of the bat.
Back of a length and outside off, punched to the covers off the back foot.
Very short ball on middle, Tiripano leans back sharply to avoid the ball as it bounces up.
Length ball around off, defended off the front foot with a straight bat.
Defended off the front foot by Tiripano presenting the full face of the bat.
SOUTHEE is back on.

Well played! Tiripano gets off the mark with a lovely stroke! Full on the stumps, the ball is flicked through mid-wicket and nearly reaches the ropes but is halted just inside. The batsmen run a triple.
Down the leg side, Tiripano lets it through.
Fullish around off, defended with an angled bat to the off side.
Length ball and swinging wide outside off, easy leave for the batsman.
Short ball on middle and off, blocked off the back foot with a straight bat.
Bouncer! Tiripano ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Good length delivery outside off, Prince square cuts it through point and straight to the fielder. Maiden over for Boult.
Fuller ball, driven through the covers.
The batsman does well to leave that bouncer.
Full on middle, driven back to the bowler.
Masvaure works it to the leg side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good length delivery outside off, pushed off the front foot to the off side. End of the over.
Short ball outside off and angling away, Tiripano thinks to play it but lets it through.
Defended off the back foot by Tiripano.
Short ball on middle and off, a slower ball, tapped to the leg side and it nearly carries to short leg.
Down the leg side, flicked to square leg.
SO CLOSE! Length ball around off, Tiripano tries to defend it and gets an inside edge that nearly hits the pads. Wagner exclaims in consternation and it is a hat-trick chance lost.
WAGNER on a hat-trick!
Back of a length ball around off, blocked with a straight bat to the off side.
Short ball outside off, Prince lets it through.
Full ball outside off, Masvaure reaches across and tries to play it but misses.
Driven towards the mid-on region.
FOUR! The batsman gets a leading edge on that one. The ball races to the boundary. The Umpire signals four runs.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
DONALD TIRIPANO comes in to bat next.

OUT! This is seriously terrific bowling and Wagner gets his THIRD FIVE-FOR in Tests! The Zimbabwean skipper lasts just one ball. Wagner digs in a shortish ball around the hips, Cremer tries to keep it out but it catches his gloves and lobs up to short leg. Nicholls stationed there dives forward to complete the catch. Poor, very poor from Zimbabwe, they are showing zero stomach to fight. This is Test cricket, a real test of your skills, technique and temperament and I'm sorry, Zimbabwe are looking completely out of place.
Skipper GRAEME CREMER is the next batsman in.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Wagner continues to run amok! He dishes out a back of a length ball around off, angling away once again, Chakabva feels for it as he is stuck on the back foot and gets a faint outside edge behind to the keeper. Watling makes no mistake and Zimbabwe are in serious danger of getting bowled out under 100!
Back of a length ball outside off, angling away, Chakabva shoulders arms.
Nothing different, Wagner believes in equality as he receives the new batsman with a lethal bouncer. Good morning, Sir! Chakabva takes his eyes off the ball and ducks.
REGIS CHAKABVA is the new man in.

OUT! Raza falls as well! Wagner digs in another short ball around middle, Raza stands back to get on top of the bounce but it gets big on him and he ends up turning it in the air towards square leg. A simple catch to Tom Latham. Third wicket for Wagner!
Wagner continues with his short pitch bowling and hurls in another sharp delivery around leg, Raza ducks.
Similar ball and the batsman defends it off the front foot and into the ground.
Masvaure steps forward again and defends it to the leg side.
Floated around off, defended off the front foot.
PRINCE MASVAURE is the next batsman in. He is making his international Test debut.

OUT! DOWN THE TRACK AND STUMPED! Looped around off, Ervine dances down the track and looks to slog the ball. It is an off spinner, he misjudges the length, swings and misses. The ball goes into the hands of the keeper who is quick to dislodge the bails. The fielding side erupt into cheers and the umpire raises the finger. Just when the partnership was looking promising!
Flatter one outside off, cover driven through the gap and the batsmen get a single.
Tossed up around off, defended to the off side.
SANTNER is back on.
Fuller outside off, Ervine does well to push it through the covers for a couple.
Another body blow! Short ball on middle, Ervine leans back and is hit once again in the chest. He did well to get his hands out of the way but this cannot go on for long.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Short ball on middle and leg, Raza stands tall and flicks it through fine leg.  The fielder waiting deep stops it and the batsmen get a single.

Short ball and it looks like Ervine has blocked it to the off side and the batsmen take a single. Replays show that Ervine was hit on the helmet! Leg byes given by the umpire. Ervine looks dazed, and I must say, Zimbabwe's helmets are getting a real workout today!
Bouncer! Raza ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Outside off, Raza steps forward but lets it through.
FOUR! Full around off, Raza steps forward and square drives it, slightly opening the face of his bat. That was excellently timed and flies through the covers and to the fence.
Bouncer! Raza ducks in time to avoid it.
Defended off the back foot by Raza.
Full around off, driven through the covers and straight to the fielder.
Short ball outside off, left alone.
MISSED CHANCE! Good length delivery on the stumps, Ervine looks to defend it but the ball rides up his bat and is flighted to silly point. The fielders run to it but are not able to make it in time.
Short ball on middle, Ervine leans back to avoid it but not enough and is struck solidly in the chest.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, superbly guided through fine leg and the ball races to the boundary.
Short ball angling away, Ervine leans back to let it go outside the off stump.
Good length delivery down the leg side, Ervine looks to flick and the ball hits him high on the thigh pad and nearly carries to short leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length ball on the pads, worked to square leg.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Length ball outside off, Raza gets behind it and punches it through the covers. The fielder chases it in vain as the ball goes for a boundary.
Very full around off, driven to the fielder at mid on. The batsmen pick up two. Well bowled, played and fielded!
A tad outside off, Raza lets the length ball through.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for Raza.
TRENT BOULT will bowl from the other end.
Too full and way outside off, Ervine drives it between cover and mid off and picks up a couple of runs.
This one is clipped through square leg as well for a run.
On the pads this time, this is flicked through square leg for a single.
Another short one outside leg, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Wagner continue to bomb in the short ones, on middle and leg this time, Ervine shuffles across and awkwardly lets the ball go just beside him, from behind him actually.
Starts off from around the wicket, a length ball on the hips, nudged towards short fine leg.

We are back for the second session of the day. The Kiwis are well on top here and will look to get an early breakthrough here. Raza and Ervine are in the middle and they will have to really dig deep here. It will be a true test of their character. Wagner will start things off with the ball.
... DAY 1, SESSION 2...

The inexperience of the Zimbabwean batsmen showed. Although this will be a good learning experience for them, they were unable to deal with the short balls they were showered with.They have a daunting task ahead of them and the break couldn't have come any sooner. They'll look to regroup and come back with a solid game plan for the second session. Join us at 1540 IST.

Special mention has to be given to Neil Wagner. He was outstanding and bowled superbly. Really bent his back and gave everything for his skipper. He terrorized the Zimbabwean batsmen with his short balls and kept them on the back foot, both literally and figuratively. Was immense for his team.

Well, it was expected New Zealand would dominate but what has happened here might have surprised some. After being put to bowl first, the visitors have thoroughly dominated this opening session and are well on top, and it started with Southee getting a breakthrough off the second ball of the day. Wagner then chipped in with a couple of wickets and Santner got one to his name as well.
Fuller ball around off, blocked back to the bowler. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Bouncer outside off, Raza dodges it, this time keeping his eyes on the ball and staying side on.
Full on the pads, Raza does well to defend it to the off side.
Length ball outside off, Raza stays side on and punches it off the back foot to the covers for a brace.
Short ball on middle, Raza turns away, taking his eyes off the ball. His duck helps him avoid the ball but puts him in a dangerous place.
Back of a length ball around off, punched to the covers.
Yorker, Ervine does well to jam it out.
Short ball on middle and angling away, Ervine does well to leave it.
Ervine chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Back of a length, tapped to square leg for a single
FOUR! Raza finally answers back. Length ball outside off, and it is the line he has been waiting for. He reaches across and punches it through the covers for a boundary.
Short ball on middle and leg, Raza keeps the bat and gloves away again, but takes his eyes off the ball to take another painful blow on the shoulder.

NOT OUT! Fuller ball around off, Ervine drives it straight back to the bowler who attempts a one-handed catch. The ball is deflected off his hands and hits the stumps. The umpire wants conformation and sends the decision upstairs. The replay shows that Raza turns back in time and has his bat well in the crease before the deflection sends the bails flying. The Third Umpire gives the green light and the batsman survives.
A run out decision against Raza is referred upstairs.
Southee mixes it up with a full ball on middle and off. Ervine does well to play it, digging it out to mid-wicket.
Another short one, swinging away, Ervine leans back and lets it go past.
Short ball on middle, Ervine keeps his hands away again and manfully takes the ball on the shoulder.
Around off, Ervine has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good delivery! Ervine reaches across but the ball swings back in and he wisely leaves it as it passes just wide of the off stump.
Length ball outside off, Raza looks to slog it but misjudges the length and misses.
Short delivery angling away, Raza leans back to let it go outside the off stump.
Bouncer! Raza sways back at the last moment to avoid it.
Short ball on middle and off, Raza blocks it with a little jump. Wagner is truly making use of the bouncy pitch.
Back of a length ball on middle, Ervine nudges it to square leg and the batsmen sneak in a single.
Back with the bouncers, Wagner sends one over Ervine.
Southee with a yorker fired in on off, Raza gets an inside edge which just goes past the leg stump as he tries to keep it out.
On middle and leg, tapped to the on side for no run.

Another sharp one from Tim, short and on the body, Raza does well to get his hands behind and not fend the ball. Gets hit on the shoulder as the ball lobs back to the keeper. An appeal for a caught behind but the umpire isn't interested.

Southee comes from around the wicket this time and the idea is clear, he's going to test him with a short ball. Bangs it in short and hard, Sikandar has to really be alert and does well to duck under it quickly.
Around off, a solid back foot defense from the batsman.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Raza opens the face of the bat and punches it through cover-point. Gets a couple of runs for it.
TIM SOUTHEE is back on.
Short ball around off, the left-hander arches his back and lets it through.
Aimed at the hips this time, Craig is struck on the thigh pad as he tries to nudge this away.
Tighter line and cramps Ervine for room, back of a length this time, the southpaw does well to get right behind the line to block it out.
Outside leg, Ervine pushes this away a little square on the leg side. Gets no run for it.
Another one banged in short and hard on middle and leg, Craig ducks to let it sail over him.
Wagner continues, comes around the wicket and hits the deck hard once more, bowls a length ball across the batsman which is left alone.
From around the wicket to the right-hander, a ball with some decent flight on it, pushed to the off side to end the over.
On middle and leg, it's worked down to short fine leg for a quick single.
Floats it up on off, Craig comes forward to block it out.
Tossed up on middle, very little spin as Ervine gets down to paddle sweep it fine down the leg side. Guptill gives it the chase as the batsmen take two runs.
Flatter one going down leg, Ervine looks to nudge this away but misses as the ball goes off his thigh pad. Appeals for a caught behind but correctly turned down.
Full on middle and off, worked to short leg.
Back of a length delivery, Raza stands tall and blocks it.
Full and wide outside off, Raza looks to play it but misses.
Bouncer! Wagners keeps the batsmen on his toes and sends Raza ducking to avoid it.
Back of a length and swinging away, left alone.
SIKANDAR RAZA is the new man in.

OUT! Wagner goes in for the shorter one again! On middle and Williams hunches his shoulders and appears to pull it to mid-wicket. The ball is lobbed straight into the fielder's hands for an easy catch. Williams gestures to his helmet but the umpire raises his finger. Wickets tumbling here for the hosts. However, replays show that the ball did actually come straight off his helmet. Poor Williams, Zimbabwe will rue to lack of DRS.
Williams will have a change of helmet as he was hit nastily on that bouncer. Seems some part of it has come off. He seems fine, though, and that's the important part.

Oh, that was nasty! Short ball on the stumps, Williams misjudges the line of the delivery, and the ball bounces up sharply and smacks the batsman straight on the face of the helment. Wagner surprised Williams with that bouncer there!
Some nice flight given on this as it's pitched on middle and off, flicked to mid-wicket. No run taken. End of a successful over from Santner.
Comes over the wicket to Williams, floats it up outside off, Sean opens the face of the bat and pushes it towards cover-point for a single. Gets off the mark.
SEAN WILLIAMS is the next batsman in.

OUT! NOW SANTNER JOINS THE PARTY! A soft dismissal really. Tossed up on middle and off, Masakadza drives this on the up straight back to the spinner. It's a simple take for him and now, the experienced Zimbabwean has to depart. Big wicket this for the tourists. Two wickets in two overs now for New Zealand.
Nicely tossed up on middle and off, Hamilton is taken by surprise it seems and just manages to keep it out.
Floated around off, driven to wide mid off for no run.
Flatter and shorter on middle and off, continuing from around the wicket, Masakadza pulls it to short mid-wicket.
Goes down the leg side and it's left alone. Top stuff from the left-arm pacer here. End of a brilliant over from him.
From around the wicket this time as Wagner decides to have a change of angles, rips in a sharp bouncer which Ervine ducks under.
CRAIG ERVINE is the new man in.

OUT! WAGNER GETS HIS JUST REWARDS! He deserves it. He's been terrific so far. Back of a length delivery around off, Chibhabha rocks back and pulls this in the air towards mid-wicket. Doesn't get a hold of this at all and it's a simple take for Latham who runs to his right a few paces and takes a good catch. Second wicket down for the hosts.
Down the leg side, pushed to square leg for no run.
Brilliant! Bangs this one in short and fast over middle and off, Chamu has to hurry to duck under it.

Wagner is on fire here. Really bending his back and giving everything his all. Fires a fuller length delivery across the batsman, just outside off, Chibhabha tries to push it away but the ball just whizzes past the outside edge.
Floated on the pads, worked to square leg for a single.
On middle and leg, played to mid-wicket for a single.
Masakadza steps forward and defends it by getting behind the line of the delivery.
Slower leg spinner outside off, takes the shoulder of the bat as Masakadza steps forward.
Outside off, played to point for a single.
Tossed up around off, Chibhabha steps forward and defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Another short delivery, Masakadza gets on his knee but shoulders his arms.
Bouncer outside off, Masakadza sways back to evade it.
Brilliant bowling! Short ball on middle, Masakadza gets his hands out of the way but is not quick enough to move his head and the ball hits his helmet and is flighted to the keeper.
Good length ball outside off, defended off the back foot to the off side.
Back of a length, swinging away, Masakadza leaves it.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Looped in a bit quicked, blocked to the off side with a straight bat.
Around off, pushed to short extra cover.

Well saved! Length ball a tad wide outside off, punches it through square leg and nearly finds the boundary but a dedicated effort by the fielders as they scoop it back ahead of the boundary saves the boundary. Good running between the wickets to pick up three runs.
Tossed up around off, slower delivery, blocked to the off side.
Loopy ball on the pads, driven back to the bowler.
Drinks break!
Good length delivery on the stumps, angling in, Chibhabha works it through the on side. The batsmen run a brace.
Back of a length ball outside off, Chibhabha plays the square cut through point.
Fullish outside off, defended from within the crease.
Length ball down the leg side, Chibhabha thinks to flick it but the ball is going too wide.
The ball swings away from the off stump and is a comfortable leave for Chibhabha.
Short ball around off, blocked off the back foot to the leg side. This is shaping up to be a good contest between bat and ball.
NEIL WAGNER is brought into the bowling attack.
On off, Chibhabha waits and drives it through mid off. The batsmen run a single but there is a throw at the bowler's end which misses. That could nearly have been a run out.

Chibhabha steps forward, frustrated with being kept in the crease but the ball swings in and hits his pads. There is an appeal from the bowler but the ball looks like it way going wide of the leg stump and the umpire doesn't go in for it.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Loopy ball around off, blocked with the full face of the bat to the off side.
Around off, defended off the front foot.
MITCHELL SANTNER into the attack.
Short ball on middle, the inswinger passes over Masakadza's shoulder. He looks to work it but misses. The fielding side appeal but the umpire isn't interested.
Bouncer! This time Masakadza has his bat raised to play it but the ball swings in over his head and he has to duck at the last moment.
Bouncer! Masakadza reacts quickly with a duck and lets the ball go past.
Full around off, pushed with the bottom of the bat back to the bowler.
Length ball on the pads, Masakadza defends it from the crease.
Down the leg side and there is a bit of an appeal as Masakadza looks to flick it but misses. The keeper collects it but the umpire shakes his head as the ball brushed his pads.
Outside off, defended to point.
Good length delivery outside off, guided to the slips.
Fuller ball outside off, swings away sharply and Chibhabha lets it through.
Around off, a front foot defence once more to the off side.
Full outside off, Chibhabha steps forward and blocks it with a straight bat.
Fuller around off, Chibhabha comes forward and defends it.
Full outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Short ball outside off, Southee has been sending Masakadza back and now he pushes back with a booming pull through backward square leg and the ball races to the boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, shaping away from the batsman and looking for that edge again, Masakadza defends it to the off side.
Back of a length ball around off, Masakadza rears up and blocks it with a straight bat.
Length ball outside off, defended to the off side.
Back of a length ball outside off, defended off the back foot to point for a single.
Length ball outside off, pushed to the covers.
Length ball around off, Masakadza looks to drive it to the off side but the ball shapes in and he is forced to punch it away.
Bouncer! Masakadza leans back and the ball passes sharply outside the off stump.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Nicely driven! Full around off, Masakadaza maintains his form beautifully to drive it to mid on. Is unlucky not to get any runs for it.
Good length delivery outside off, swinging away from the batsman, Masakadza lets it through.
Shorter ball a tad outside off, Chibhabha shoulders his arms to let it through.
Chibhabha gets forward and solidly blocks that outswinger.
Shortish ball outside off, defended off the back foot with the full face of the bat.
Length ball outside off, defends it to the off side.
Short ball on middle, Masakadza pulls it through square leg for a single.
Length ball on the stumps, Masakadza carefully pushes it to mid on.
Boult comes from around the wicket this time, bowls a fuller length delivery on middle and leg, it's flicked to mid-wicket to end the over.
Way outside off, full in length, the batsman has nothing to do with that.
FOUR! Good shot. Shortish on middle and off, Chibhabha rocks back and with absolute ease, pulls it through backward square leg to pick up a boundary.
Full outside off, driven to mid off. No run taken.
Full on leg, the ball shapes back in and hits him on the pads as Chamu looks to flick this away to the on side.

Length delivery coming in to the batsman, Chibhabha is struck on the thigh pad as he tries to bring his bat on ball. Appeals for an lbw but that was never going to be given out as height was the issue.
FOUR! Shot. That's beautiful. Full outside off, Masakadza leans into the shot and drives it superbly through the covers. Sends it all the way to the boundary. That will ease some nerves.
Straying down the leg side this time, Masakadza glances this fine down the leg side. Goes past a diving Watling as the Zimbabwean batsmen take two more.

Overpitched on off, some out-swing here, Chamu drives this straight back down the ground. Doesn't time it perfectly but it's enough to get him three runs. The fielders from mid on and mid off chase after it and manage to keep it from the ropes. Good team work.
A sharp one. It's banged in short on middle and off, Chibhabha is taken by surprise but does well to duck and let it sail over him.
Back of a length outside off, Chamu camps back and pushes it to the off side off his back foot.
Too straight, on middle and leg and once again some away swing for Tim, but Chibhabha has no trouble clipping this down towards deep backward square leg for a couple. Some runs for Zimbabwe.
Well outside off, left alone and that's the end of the over.
Length delivery outside off, Hamilton doesn't bother with this one.
Tighter line from the pacer this time as he bowls it just around off, makes it come in slightly to the batsman, Masakadza leans forward and keeps it out well.
On a length and angled across the batsman, straightens up after pitching, Masakadza goes back, withdraws his bat and lets it go past him.
Better line from the bowler as he aims this one on the stumps, kept out well by the No.3 batsman.
A delivery which is pitched just a touch fuller on the pads, Hamilton works it towards mid-wicket.
Chibhabha is getting some treatment as he hit on the last delivery. The physio is out but it doesn't seem like anything major. Should be okay to continue.
Shortish and on the rib-cage, goes off the arm and lobs in front of the batsman. End of the over.
Back of a length around off, Chamu pulls this straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Fuller in length from Southee this time, Chamu prods forward and pushes it towards the cover region.
This one is pitched just around the off stump, the batsman gets right behind the line of the delivery and blocks it out.

Just enough movement away and that's another excellent delivery. Touch fuller in length and outside off, Chibhaha comes forward to play at this but is beaten at all ends by the away swings. Could have easily nicked that.
Length ball just outside off, Chibhabha stays back and keeps it out nicely.
After an eventful first over, Southee is pumped up. Has 4 slips and a gully in place.
Trent makes this go away from the right-hander, no shot offered by the batsman.
Fuller length delivery outside off, it's driven to mid off for no run.
Boult isn't wasting any time here. Has the swing and wants to make the most of it. Fires in a fast inswinging yorker on middle and leg, Masakadza does well to keep this one out.
Length ball outside off, the batsman goes back and blocks it out to the off side.
Full and swinging in around off, Hamilton with a solid straight bat defense.
Leg bye! Aimed at the hips, goes off Chibhabha's thigh pad as he looks to work this to the leg side. Goes off his thigh pad towards backward square leg as a leg bye is taken by the batsman.
TRENT BOULT will bowl from the other end.
Nice shape once again from Southee, he must be loving this here, bowls a length delivery outside off, away swing on that once again, left alone by the batsman. End of an eventful first over.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot this time.

Excellent delivery! Southee is bowling extremely well here. Once again on a good length, in the channel outside off, Masakadza looks to defend this with a straight bat but is beaten at all ends. The ball just goes past the outside edge and into the keeper's gloves.
Good length delivery outside off, Masakadza leaves it alone.
HAMILTON MASAKADZA walks in at No.3.

OUT! EARLY SUCCESS FOR SOUTHEE! And that's a good delivery. Tim's bowled it back of a length and outside off, a little straighter I think this time, and it has some away movement too. Chari has a poke at this and gets a healthy edge. Flies to second slip where Martin Guptill takes a good catch. Chari has to make the long walk back to the pavilion.

FOUR! Even if that's gone for a boundary Southee will be encouraged with the swing he's witnessed there. Full and swinging away outside off, Chari looks to play at this but ends up getting a thick outside edge which flies past the slip cordon and gully. Races away to the third man fence for a boundary.

So, we are done and dusted with the national anthems and the team photographs and are all set to get underway. CHAMU CHIBHABHA and BRIAN CHARI will open the innings for the home side. TIM SOUTHEE will start with the new ball first up. Let's go...

A noticeable absentee for Zimbabwe will be Chatara. He was the only experienced bowler in the side and he has been ruled out of the series with an ankle injury which he picked up in the warm-up game. They have three debutants however - Prince, Chinouya and Chibhabha. New faces who will look to prove themselves.

Pitch Report - A decent length at the airport end with clear areas or areas with insubstantial grass. That means there will not be much pace. The pitch sounds like its been rolled quite a bit and will hold together quite well. It looks like the spinners will come out to play and bowlers will have to work hard for wickets.

New Zealand skipper, Kane Williamson.says that it is a good surface for batting. He says Santner is the all rounder and will play in the middle. The bowling will include three seamers and two spinners.

Zimbabwe captain, Graeme Cremer says that he will have a bat first. The wicket looks good for batting to him. Captaining his side is totally fine for him and he knows his teammates will make it easier for me. He will have two front line spinners and 2 back line seamers.
ZIMBABWE WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT FIRST!

New Zealand on the other hand have a full strength squad, right till Ross Taylor and are absolutely prepared to step out on the field. They've had a good week long's conditioning session in South Africa which will certainly aid them in this tour. The kiwis are entering a new era after the retirement of Brendon McCullum and would like to start on a positive note under Kane Williamson. They'll be confident going into this match after having a good warm-up game. They are the clear favourites obviously to clinch this but we hope Zimbabwe can give them a run for their money.

The hosts last played a Test back in 2014 and since then, have had no practice in the purest format whatsoever. The return of the game there will be very welcome for the home side. They will be led by Graeme Cremer, so are in good hands, but the side has the stink of inexperience. The team will have 3 debutants and there are some known faces, but they are yet to prove themselves in this format.

After much speculation about whether this series would take place due to the on-going protests in Zimbabwe, over civil and political issues, the 2-match Test series is finally ready to get underway. New Zealand will tour the Rhodesians country to battle it out in the longest format of the game.
